421666.overview:
Feel the awesome power of a really dumb duck!

This is no ordinary duck. This is Dummy Duck. He’s like a normal duck, but he’s really dumb! And the fate of the world is in his hands! It’s up to you to prevent him from goofing everything up!

First of all, you must contact each of Dummy’s friends. They’ll give you special items like a crazy huge sword, some coffee mugs (good for chucking across the room!) and also, corn. You’ll have to protect yourself and your friends from the robots which have gone crazy all over the city! Not only that, but I think the boss of that café is pretty mad at you too! What’s the deal with that? Who can find the key? It’s Dummy Duck!

 This demo was made with NES Maker!

421673.overview:
A port of Atari 7800 version of Desert Falcon that was featured on the first Atari Flashback console in 2004. Developer Nice Code Software ported the game to the NES because the original Atari Flashback console utilized an "NES-on-a-Chip" architecture. A good port of the coin-op classic.

You are the royal Desert Falcon questing for precious gems and Egyptian heiroglyphs hidden in the endless desert. Invincibility, warp speed, and quick shots are only some of the many magical powers you'll gain on your search. Use them to capture a trove of treasures. But watch out for the evil ones! Mythical flying beasts, blazing firepots, and howling sphinxes guard the jewels you seek.

423841.overview:
Mod 1-player game to support 2-players game simultaneously. Second player is Darkwing Duck!

New in version 1.4a (31 Jan 2017):
- select for 1 player or 2 players game. 1-player game matches original.
- game slowdowns reduced.
- improved sprites showing on hardware/with sprite limit enabled.
- many bugs fixed.
- some other improvements.

424004.overview: Armed with kunai knives and shuriken stars, not much is known about this mysterious ninja. He was invited to join the Shadow Warriors, if he could make it all the way to the leader, and defeat him using his ninja skills...

424021.overview: This hack is dated 33th anniversary of the video game of the same name, as well as the upcoming premiere of the full-length animated film Don Bluth. Now you are finally able to go to your favorite game on your favorite console without the torment that you experienced while playing the original game.

424076.overview: Dragon Ball Z 5 is an unlicensed Beat 'em up for the Famicom, based on the Dragon Ball Z anime. The game's story loosely retells the events of Dragon Ball Z up to the Cell Saga.

424191.overview:
This is a little improve to certain graphic details in the game, very punctually in the sprites, the changes are as follows.

-Black line in the sprites of the playable character and other characters.
-Small graphic changes in certain enemies.
-That enemy that looks like a rabbit but that is not …Well, now is changed to look like evil rabbits.
-Change of look for the final boss, now it has more human appearance instead of just being a black thing.
-Small changes in the skin of the princess, now it will not seem so much a princess Leia.

424499.overview: Rockman Deus Ex Machina is one of the best sophisticated hacks in Mega Man II history. It is programmed almost every part of the game you’ve never expected before. The boss fights are incredibly hyperactive. Players find this hack a clear winner. Background Music is made by the author of Rockman No Constancy IKA. Additional patches were added by Misty in the Japanese 2ch boards about August 8th such as Hard Body and Weapon Modification. A must play for all expert Mega Man II players. Not newbies.

448110.overview: Despite what some angry internet nerds may think, Die Hard for NES is a great game. Most of the criticism seems aimed towards the games poor graphics. This hack aims to rectify that by redesigning most of the games graphics and also the difficulty has been lowered a bit by adjusting some key values for better balance and fun.

449455.overview:
Data Man is a new game for the NES (Nintendo Entertainment System) that brings arcade action to your home console.

Defend your System from the corrupted Master and his minions!

The Master and his evil minions have invaded the system and will not stop until every piece of data is corrupted. It’s up to you to save it before time runs out and the system crashes! It won’t be easy. You’ll have to protect the Central Processing Unit from hordes of attacking minions and ultimately from the Master himself. Face it alone, or with a friend!

451514.overview: Donkey Kong with HD graphics for Mesen emulator

451563.overview: Chu Da D (鋤大D) is a Famicom game developed by Ex-Sachen developers and published by Fortune Power/Jichang in 1995. The aim is to win the championship by playing against various Hong Kong movie actors such as Jacky Cheung (張學友), Stephen Chow (周馳星), and Maggie Cheung (張曼玉). Each stage is split into six levels and to proceed to the next stage, one must obtain a certain amount of money. The game also features two difficulty modes and an instructions screen.

453634.overview: This version of Double Dragon gives the game an Arcade makeover. All enemies have been updated more to their arcade counterpart. The title screen has been reverted back to the arcade title screen. Billy also looks more like his arcade counterpart now.  Also, Jeff has been restored as an enemy in the place of Chin. Jeff has also replaced Chin in the Versus Mode as well. Thanks to Daniel Kay for requesting.

456025.overview: A graphic pack for the Mesen NES emulator, with the goal to stay as close as possible to the original content (colors, design) but trying to make the graphics more appealing (16-bit like, even).

456826.overview:
Mod/hack adds fourth and third (1-8) players to Chip n Dale 2 to make it possible to play the game with four (8) people at the same time.

Also: Balance: bosses, enemies. Level select. Mini-games select.

458899.overview: What if... Daimyo the undead slaying Pomeranian was the main character of Dungeons & DoomKnights? Download this ROM on BackerKit now and find out.  The game's dialog was completely re-written and the skill changes are hilarious. Daimyo is an unstoppable undead wrecking ball. Every skeleton and boss monster he touches appears to disintegrate. It is perfect for very young players (or anyone who wants to laugh through the game with very little challenge).

458914.overview: Doodle World Redrawn is a new, never before released, re-imagining of Doodle World with tougher levels, enemies, and bosses! Use the new double jump ability to navigate through these tougher levels.

459082.overview:
This is an ‘Easy Mode’ patch for "Dragoon X Omega v2.0f: Gold Edition".

Too many changes to list here but you will receive multiple IPS patches in the archive and can mix & match whatever you like to suit your preferences. Now YOU can choose how easy you want the game to be.

In addition, the namesake of this hack is part of the Amnethen Cult sidequest. In gaming terms, the world map has been significantly altered and redone in many ways to differ from the original DXO1.

459474.overview:
Dangerous descent is a story-driven survival horror game for the NES retro console.

The game draws inspiration from famous games like Resident Evil and Silent Hill.  Players will need to collect items, find keys, solve riddles and, of course, fight monsters.

459527.overview:
Doodle World 2 is an all new game for the NES featuring the same fun retro platforming action that the series is known for.

King Eraser is back and he has stolen all the Super Crayons! Guide Doodle through 20 levels featuring the amazing pixel art showcasing the series had drawn asthetic. Defeat King Eraser and all his minions to, once again, save Doodle World.

459753.overview:
In Ddream Ddiver you play the role of a slumbering scientist, trying to stay asleep long enough to talk to her late father.

Dodge sea creatures, avoid jagged rocks, and find your way to the dive bar.

Explore creepy caves, crystal formations and ancient ruins as you breaststroke your way through 30 stages of illusion.

459802.overview: Dig through the earth in a remote controlled drill. Collect enough money to earn your freedom.

459901.overview: When all of the world's magic is banned by the evil wizard Cloptimus, you answer the call to adventure! Seek him out in his dastardly castle and defeat him! Become a hero and restore magic to the land and its people!

459994.overview: Drow Tactics is a strategy RPG in which you must create a party of 3 heroes and battle through 10 maps by defeating the bosses that guard each goal. For each character, you can choose to be a fighter or a mage, and then choose 1 of 5 affinities (wood, fire, earth, metal, or water), for a total of ten classes, each with unique stats growths. Between battles you can shop to supply your heroes with restorative items or stat boosts. The game features an auto-save system.

460065.overview: The player ship is only vulnerable at the core - bullets will pass harmlessly through the rest of the ship

461191.overview: Droll Ball is a retro puzzle game for the NES, created with Retro Puzzle Maker 1.5.

462554.overview: This is an HD pack for Dig Dug, exclusively for the Mesen NES emulator. It replaces many textures in order for the game to look more like the arcade equivalent.

462565.overview: Duck Hunt Remastered is an HD pack exclusively for the Mesen NES emulator. It replaces the backgrounds along with the character sprites.

462566.overview: An HD pack for the Mesen emulator which makes the game more colorful using PNG images, including some custom backgrounds.

462639.overview: Enter the harrowing world of "Desert Of The Undead," where the line between duty and family blurs amidst the chaos of a zombie apocalypse. Play as John Maverick, a once-decorated Navy SEAL turned devoted family man and successful businessman. Returning from a routine business trip, John's world is shattered as he finds his serene desert town overrun by hordes of ravenous zombies.

462670.overview:
Scrooge and his nephews discover a piece of a map, it leads to the location of the McDuck fortune.  Flintheart Glomgold is also after the treasure.  Travel the world to get all the pieces to claim the fortune.

Duck Tales 2 New Journey is a romhack of DuckTales 2 featuring all new redesigned levels and many secret areas.

On November 18th 2024, the romhack was "updated" to version 2.0 which integrated 2 player co-operative gameplay and completely redesigned levels as well as changed the behavior of some bosses.  These changes also made it  to where the game cannot be played 100% by one player.  Some pieces of maps and some treasures cannot be taken by one player, and it is very difficult to reach all the bosses with one player.   Previous single-player versions (e.g. 1.0 or 1.1) of DuckTales 2 New Journey are no longer published by the developer online.

465129.overview:
Enter the harrowing world of "Desert Of The Undead," where the line between duty and family blurs amidst the chaos of a zombie apocalypse. Play as John Maverick, a once-decorated Navy SEAL turned devoted family man and successful businessman. Returning from a routine business trip, John's world is shattered as he finds his serene desert town overrun by hordes of ravenous zombies.

Armed with his military training and a fierce determination to protect his loved ones, John embarks on a relentless quest to reclaim his hometown. Traverse through four intense stages, each more treacherous than the last, as you battle your way through waves of undead adversaries. From the Town outskirts, Underground Caverns, abandoned streets and mayors mansion, every corner holds a new threat.

But beware, for lurking within the shadows are formidable bosses, each possessing their own unique strengths and weaknesses. Face off against these monstrous foes in heart-pounding battles that will test your skill and strategy to the limit.

With gripping gameplay, classic 8 bit visuals, and an immersive storyline, "Desert Of The Undead" promises an unforgettable gaming experience. Will you rise to the challenge and reclaim what's rightfully yours, or succumb to the relentless tide of the undead? The fate of John Maverick's town rests in your hands.

471008.overview:
To celebrate DKC’s 30th anniversary (a little late), here’s a hack for the bootleg version (DKC 4) of the NES. This hack improves the gameplay so it feels more like the original. It also includes new sprites, better music, changes to the levels and color palettes, and more.

Changes:

    Improved controls for DK and Diddy.
    New sprites for DK ,Diddy and enemies.
    Improved music.
    Changes to levels and palettes.
    Ending screen added.

473612.overview:
Dark Pillage is a game about Rhaztharak, a goblin who wishes to pillage the legendary Maze of the Undead Dragon King.

Your objective is to collect all the treasures in each room!

477402.overview:
Here is a full ROM hack for Darkwing Duck. New levels, 1 new weapons, new bosses, and new graphics have been added. The language is Japanese, but you should be able to fully play the game with no issues.

In v1.1 various bugs were fixed, the original music was returned and some places on the levels were changed (it became easier to pass). The archive contains 2 patches - “Easy” and “Hard”. In “Easy”-version there is no additional 4th weapon and it is not possible to collect all additional weapons and switch between them. Also, the AI of the bosses here is the same as in the original, unmodified game.

477531.overview:
Jump, dig and drill across various biomes in the cavern, filled with wonders, dangers, and secrets waiting to be discovered.

Get picks to unlock new abilities and move through both air and ground with incredible agility.
Find the treasure lost underground, forced to repay your debt to the mafia, who embedded a pick in your head as punishment.

Developed by Novasplore Games, Broke Studio published the physical release through Homebrew Factory. Novasplore later released digital copies through Steam.

478115.overview:
A port of the pirate original GameBoy Color RPG Digimon 3 by Vast Fame. The game is loosely based on the third Digimon anime series, Digomon Tamers, but features a new story unrelated to the anime. 

Nanjing also released the game, with a title screen hack, as Shu Ma Zhan Dui 2, which translates to Digimon Adventures 2, the title of the second Digimon anime series.

478238.overview: An RPG based off the classic Chinese novel Water Margin.

478265.overview: An RPG based off the Chinese novel The Deer and the Cauldron.

478319.overview:
The game was originally released by Nanjing as San Guo Zhi: Zhi Ao Shi Tian Di. The original version had a game-breaking bug that softlocked the game and made it impossible to complete. The game was rereleased as 
Ao Shi San Guo Zhi with the bug fixed.

The game is an RPG that is based off of the early chapters of the classic Chinese novel Romance of the Three Kingdoms.

478358.overview:
Lu Bu Zhuan is the second game in Nanjing's San Guo Zhi trilogy. Like the other games in the trilogy, this is an original RPG, but its mechanics are based on Capcom's Destiny of the Emporer games. Also, like Destiny of the Emporer, the game's storyline is based on the classic Chinese novel Romance of the Three Kingdom. In the game the player plays as Lu Bu.

The game was preceeded by San Gou Zhi: Cao Cao Zhuan, and it was followed by Tun Shi Tian Di 6: Liu Bei Zhuan

Lu Bu Zhuan was rereleased by Nanjing as San Guo Wu Shuang: Meng Jiang Zhuan, or Dynasty Warriors: Extreme Legends.

478359.overview:
Liu Bei Zhuan is the third and final game in Nanjing's San Guo Zhi trilogy. It was proceeded by San Gou Zhi: Cao Cao Zhuan and San Guo Zhi: Lu Bu Zhuan. Unlike the previous games, this game is titled Tun Shi Tian Di 6, or Destiny of the Emperor 6, making it an official sequel to the Capcom RPGs.

like the other games in the trilogy, Liu Bei Zhuan is an original RPG that uses mechanics based on Capcom's Destiny of the Emporer games. Also, like Destiny of the Emperor, the game's storyline is based on the classic Chinese novel Romance of the Three Kingdom. In the game the player plays as Liu Bei.

The game is sometimes listed as San Guo Zhi: Liu Bei Zhuan, keeping with the naming conventions of the earlier games in the trilogy.

478998.overview:
You are Dr. Sexy, and you have entered the Grand Bake-Off. What could go wrong?

Everything. Across thirteen escalating rounds — from a humble community center to a castle to the final showdown with a screaming celebrity chef — you'll tackle ten distinct baking minigames: mash the batter, nail the pour, pull the cake at the perfect golden second, pipe the decoration, catch the falling patties, keep your balance, and dodge the mess. Every dish is judged on four categories, including the all-important Sexanomics.

Clear the bar and you advance. Come up short and the judge doesn't send you home — they step into the ring.

Dr Sexy's Grand Bake-Off Brawl is two games in one: a twitchy baking-rhythm gauntlet bolted to a bare-knuckle wrestling engine, where a bad soufflé is just the opening bell. A roster of thirteen wildly mismatched judges stands between you and the title, each with their own tastes, their own taunts, and their own chin.

How your run ends is up to you. Bake clean and honest, or become The Heel who punches their way to the top. Pass on charisma alone with a Perfect Sexanomics run, or scrape through as a Disaster Genius whose food is inedible but somehow unstoppable. Four endings, a battery-backed record of your best scores, and a difficulty curve that does not care about your feelings.

Built from scratch for the NES and tested on real hardware. No emulation crutches, no compromises — just an authentic 8-bit fever dream about pastry and violence.

480712.overview:
An unauthorized port of Vast Fame's Game Boy Color game Digital Monsters 3 for the Famicom.

Like the Game Boy Color game, Shuma Baolong 4 is an RPG based on the Digimon Adventure anime. The player can select from one of the eight Digidestined (which determines the player's sprite and starter Digimon). However, not every starter mon is paired with their corresponding kid. The game plays mostly the same but much cruder, as player portraits are sized-up tracings of the original portrait graphics and damage calculation is buggy and somewhat random. On top of this, the wild Digimon that show up in each area is not accurate, as Betamon is one of the enemies you encounter in the first dungeon when normally you only encounter baby Digimon.

Most of the music consists of unique compositions, with none of the soundtracks from the original Game Boy Color game being present. At least one of the tracks is reused from Waixing's Bio Hazard Famicom game, which was also developed by Mars Production
